answer: An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the river index resolves every citation against the zenith checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the saffron audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 2705 identities would post 3559 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
